subject: Accessline: SCIM delta + SAML assertion tracework for SOC 2 intake
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@greystone.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@greystone.com
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SCIM delta + SAML samples for upcoming SOC 2 audit

Hi Stephanie,

We're kicking off our SOC 2 evidence intake and need a focused set of artifacts from Redwood covering access provisioning and assertion telemetry. Can you help with the following by Nov 3 (our intake window)?

- SCIM delta (add/modify/delete) covering all user and group changes for the last 90 days, in CSV format; include timestamp, actor, attribute deltas, and source (IdP/API/service).
- Sample SAML assertions for 10 distinct users that show role/group claims (both successful and failed assertions if available).
- A role-to-permission matrix or mapping for the tenant (high level; we only need role names and the main permissions they confer).
- A short list of any service accounts (non-human principals) and their owner/contact + justification.
- Confirmation of any retention/rollover windows for assertion logs and SCIM deltas.

Please indicate if you need a different cutoff date or anything scoped differently. We attached the formal SOC 2 intake packet for context (SOC2-Inquiry-2026.pdf).

Thanks — if it's easier, we can schedule a 30-min call.

Lydia Park
Security Lead | Greystone Health
lydia.park@greystone.com
+1 415-555-0147

Attachment: SOC2-Inquiry-2026.pdf (application/pdf, 320KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@greystone.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML samples for upcoming SOC 2 audit

Hi Lydia — thanks for the packet and clear scope. We can deliver the items you described. Outline below is our proposed "tracework playbook" and timeline; please confirm that a 90-day cutoff to Oct 27, 2026 is fine, and whether you want assertions for federated users only (IdP: Okta) or also internal system-sourced assertions.

Proposed deliverables & timing:
- Day 0 (today): A brief spec describing CSV columns and redaction approach. (attached: redwood-scim-delta-spec.csv)
- Day 2: Redacted SCIM delta export (CSV) + role-to-permission mapping (XLSX).
- Day 4: SAML assertion samples (redacted, plain-text) + short note about retention windows.
- Day 5: Follow-up Q&A / clarification or 30-min call if needed.

Attachments included: redwood-scim-delta-spec.csv (spec), saml-assertion-examples.txt (examples).

Notes on redaction: we will pseudonymize end-user emails and remove PII before delivery; UID hashes and timestamps will be preserved to allow traceability. Service accounts and owner contacts will be provided in plain text.

Ben and Jordan — looping you in to confirm the extraction window and to capture the export query we should run.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Security Solutions | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0222

Attachments:
- redwood-scim-delta-spec.csv (text/csv, 4KB)
- saml-assertion-examples.txt (text/plain, 12KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML samples for upcoming SOC 2 audit

On Tue, Oct 27, 2026 at 12:05 PM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben and Jordan — looping you in to confirm the extraction window and to capture the export query we should run.

We can run an export against the provisioning audit table. Retention note: platform audit retains SCIM deltas and provisioning events for 180 days by default; SAML assertion logs are retained in the assertion-trace store for 365 days, but full assertion payloads are rotated out of hot storage after 90 days — we keep canonical redacted samples.

Suggested extraction params:
- Table: provisioning_prov_events (prod)
- Time range: 2026-07-29T00:00:00Z => 2026-10-27T23:59:59Z (90 days)
- Columns: event_id, ts, actor_email, actor_type (user/system), action, resource_type, resource_id, changed_fields, old_values, new_values, source

I've attached the SQL we'll run and a short script to pseudonymize email addresses before drop. We'll also collect 10 SAML assertion samples from okta-assertion-archive and redact the NameID/EPPN per your guidance.

Attachment: scim-export-query.sql (text/sql, 3KB)

Ben

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@greystone.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML samples for upcoming SOC 2 audit

Hi Lydia — quick update and delivery notes.

We completed the extraction and redaction run. Deliverables uploaded to the shared folder linked below. Redaction steps: user emails were hashed, all full names removed, timestamps and actor types preserved. Service accounts and their owners are listed in the access_ownership_map.xlsx (no redaction).

Delivered files (shared folder):
- greystone_scim_delta_redacted.csv — SCIM add/modify/delete events (90-day window)
- greystone_saml_samples_redacted.txt — 10 SAML assertion samples (NameIDs hashed, sensitive attributes redacted)
- access_ownership_map.xlsx — role mappings and service account owners

Retention and notes:
- SCIM delta export queries source events from our provisioning audit table; retention for that store is 180 days.
- Assertion payloads are accessible for up to 90 days in hot storage; we provided canonical retained samples for your review.
- All exports include event timestamps and actor_type (human/system) to satisfy traceability requirements.

Link to shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2BredwoodGreystoneShare
HubSpot record: HS-1245789

If you'd like, Ben and Jordan can join a short call to walk through the CSV columns and the role matrix. Otherwise we consider this intake delivered and will keep the full (non-redacted) artifacts available to Redwood Compliance for 30 days under the usual CA/NDAs.

Thanks — let us know any follow-ups.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Security Solutions | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0222

Attachments in folder: greystone_scim_delta_redacted.csv, greystone_saml_samples_redacted.txt, access_ownership_map.xlsx
